description: Configures SSH hosts with special IdentityFiles and hostnames.

parameters.name: add_keys_to_agent
parameters.description: Sets the AddKeysToAgent option. Choices: false true

parameters.name: controlmaster
parameters.description: Sets the ControlMaster option. Choices: "yes" "no" "ask" "auto" "autoask"

parameters.name: controlpath
parameters.description: Sets the ControlPath option.

parameters.name: controlpersist
parameters.description: Sets the ControlPersist option.

parameters.name: dynamicforward
parameters.description: Sets the DynamicForward option.

parameters.name: forward_agent
parameters.description: Sets the ForwardAgent option. Choices: false true

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Which group this configuration file belongs to. If none given, user is used.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: The endpoint this configuration is valid for. It can be an actual address on the internet or an alias that connects to the value of hostname.

parameters.name: host_key_algorithms
parameters.description: Sets the HostKeyAlgorithms option.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: The actual host to connect to when connecting to the host defined.

parameters.name: identities_only
parameters.description: Specifies that SSH should only use the configured authentication identity and certificate files (either the default files, or those explicitly configured in the ssh_config files or passed on the ssh command-line), even if ssh-agent or a PKCS11Provider or SecurityKeyProvider offers more identities. Choices: false true

parameters.name: identity_file
parameters.description: The path to an identity file (SSH private key) that is used when connecting to this host. File need to exist and have mode 0600 to be valid.

parameters.name: other_options
parameters.description: Allows specifying arbitrary SSH config entry options using a dictionary. The key names must be lower case. Keys with upper case values are rejected. The values must be strings. Other values are rejected.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The actual port to connect to when connecting to the host defined.

parameters.name: proxycommand
parameters.description: Sets the ProxyCommand option. Mutually exclusive with proxyjump.

parameters.name: proxyjump
parameters.description: Sets the ProxyJump option. Mutually exclusive with proxycommand.

parameters.name: remote_user
parameters.description: Specifies the user to log in as.

parameters.name: ssh_config_file
parameters.description: SSH config file. If user and this option are not specified, /etc/ssh/ssh_config is used. Mutually exclusive with user.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether a host entry should exist or not. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: strict_host_key_checking
parameters.description: Whether to strictly check the host key when doing connections to the remote host. The value accept-new is supported since community.general 8.6.0. Choices: "yes" "no" "ask" "accept-new"

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Which user account this configuration file belongs to. If none given and ssh_config_file is not specified, /etc/ssh/ssh_config is used. If a user is given, ~/.ssh/config is used. Mutually exclusive with ssh_config_file.

parameters.name: user_known_hosts_file
parameters.description: Sets the user known hosts file option.

examples:
- name: Add a host in the configuration
  community.general.ssh_config:
    user: akasurde
    host: "example.com"
    hostname: "github.com"
    identity_file: "/home/akasurde/.ssh/id_rsa"
    port: '2223'
    state: present
    other_options:
      serveraliveinterval: '30'

- name: Add SSH config with key auto-added to agent
  community.general.ssh_config:
    user: devops
    host: "example.com"
    hostname: "staging.example.com"
    identity_file: "/home/devops/.ssh/id_rsa"
    add_keys_to_agent: true
    state: present

- name: Delete a host from the configuration
  community.general.ssh_config:
    ssh_config_file: "{{ ssh_config_test }}"
    host: "example.com"
    state: absent

return_values.name: hosts_added
return_values.description: A list of host added. Returned: success Sample: ["example.com"]

return_values.name: hosts_change_diff
return_values.description: A list of host diff changes. Returned: on change Sample: [{"example.com": {"new": {"hostname": "github.com", "identityfile": ["/tmp/test_ssh_config/fake_id_rsa"], "port": "2224"}, "old": {"hostname": "github.com", "identityfile": ["/tmp/test_ssh_config/fake_id_rsa"], "port": "2224"}}}]

return_values.name: hosts_changed
return_values.description: A list of host changed. Returned: success Sample: ["example.com"]

return_values.name: hosts_removed
return_values.description: A list of host removed. Returned: success Sample: ["example.com"]
